bug: The Chebyshev b_1 coefficient assignment holds its prior value rather than loading the Chebyshev coefficient.
trigger: Select Butterworth (2'b00), then switch to Chebyshev (2'b01) and provide nonzero channel input history; the held b_1 value is then 2 instead of 5.
effect: Chebyshev channel results use the coefficient retained from the prior selector, producing incorrect output after that mode transition.
